meta.name: ValveOS parts-knowledge database
meta.purpose: Config-agnostic engineering knowledge keyed to the PART (partId / item sub-code), never to a step or a single manual. Configs/manuals reference partIds and pull tool/torque/check content from here at render time.
meta.primaryKey: partId (matches the STEPS id in app/src/App.jsx); Rajdeep item sub-code stored as itemSubCode
meta.resolutionOrder: part -> relationship -> interfaceRule -> categoryDefault (most specific wins)
meta.safetyRule: Never fabricate a torque, fastener size, or spec. Unconfirmed values are null with confidence 'placeholder' or 'unknown' and listed in openQuestions.
meta.canonicalHome: This file is edited only from the parts-knowledge command chat.

rules.text: Valve is NOT split for automation; only the lever handle and nameplate are removed.
rules.why: Automation only needs the stem; splitting the body is unnecessary and risks the seat.
rules.failureMode: Wasted teardown; seat/seal disturbed.

rules.text: Retain the nameplate; it is re-tied to the finished unit for tagging.
rules.why: Spec traceability on the shipped assembly.
rules.failureMode: Unit ships untagged.

rules.text: Note ball position (closed) before removing the lever.
rules.why: Preserves reference for fail-action orientation later.
rules.failureMode: Actuator fitted to wrong open/close datum.

rules.text: Design break torque approx 5 Nm at DN15 (value WITHOUT safety factor per the catalogue note). The RNP50-SR40 actuator delivers 9-13 Nm at 4 bar, so it is adequately sized with a safety margin.
rules.why: Confirms the actuator can drive the valve at the AFR-set 4 bar.
rules.failureMode: Undersized actuator would stall the valve.
rules.source: L&T catalogue p7 (valve torque data) vs Valmet catalogue p5

checks.acceptance: Full open-to-close by hand, no binding.

checks.text: Clamped square in vice, bore horizontal.
checks.acceptance: Flange faces to the line, valve not skewed.

provenance.overallConfidence: OEM-confirmed (L&T catalogue): ISO 5211 top flange = F03, bore 11 mm RB, face-to-face 108 mm, design torque ~5 Nm. Open: stem square size (not in catalogue tables); process-flange bolt spec.

lever.displayName: Valve lever / hand-operating handle (removed during automation)

rules.text: Removed during automation: only the lever and nameplate come off (the valve is not split). Keep the nameplate; refit the stem nut.
rules.why: The actuator replaces manual operation; the nameplate is reused for final tagging.
rules.failureMode: Lost nameplate; stem nut left off.

rules.text: Note the ball position (closed) before removing the lever.
rules.why: Preserves the datum for fail-action orientation.
rules.failureMode: Actuator fitted to the wrong open/close datum.

checks.text: Nameplate retained; ball position noted; stem nut refitted.
checks.acceptance: Nameplate set aside; stem nut back on.

provenance.overallConfidence: removal step confirmed; the lever .glb is a generated placeholder (swap real CAD later)

interfaces.size: valve top is ISO 5211 F03 (M5); Rajdeep bracket mounts to stop-plate ears (2x M6 per golden A3)

fasteners.source: video ground-truth + golden-steplist A3 (2 screws confirmed; size/torque placeholder)

rules.text: Bracket goes onto the VALVE first, right after the lever is removed.
rules.why: Establishes the mounting datum before the actuator is dressed and lowered.
rules.failureMode: Rework if actuator is built up before bracket is referenced.

rules.text: Bracket must sit flat with no rock.
rules.why: A rocking bracket misaligns the actuator to the stem.
rules.failureMode: Coupling binds / cross-loads the stem.

checks.text: Bracket flat on the valve pad, no rock.
checks.acceptance: No gap or rocking under hand pressure.

checks.text: ISO 5211 hole pattern up and aligned.
checks.acceptance: Actuator base holes line up without forcing.

provenance.overallConfidence: custom part; actuator-side mount = F05/M6 confirmed (Arnav). Valve-side screw size/torque still open (OQ-02).

rules.text: Coupling seats on the valve stem flats, square tang up.
rules.why: Correct orientation for the actuator pinion to engage.
rules.failureMode: Actuator will not drop / drive not transmitted.

checks.acceptance: Fully down on the flats, not perched on the stem tip.
Tang square and clean for pinion entry.

actuator.displayName: Pneumatic actuator, rack & pinion, spring return (fail-to-close / spring-to-close)

interfaces.role: valve mount (base). Offers dual F03/F05; Rajdeep uses F05 (M6) to the bracket [Arnav 2026-07-17]

interfaces.source: Valmet catalogue p25 (N A/F=14) + p28 (shaft-key type D)
Valmet catalogue p25 (M5x8 deep; port T=1/4")

interfaces.role: accessory mount (top, for limit switch box)

fasteners.source: size confirmed M6/F05 by Arnav 2026-07-17; torque not in Valmet catalogue (set per bolt grade / Rajdeep standard)
Valmet catalogue p16 tightening-torque table (RNP40-80 = M6, 8 Nm)
fasteners.confidence: confirmed (internal service torque; NOT the valve-mount torque)

rules.text: Remove the top cap / position indicator and wipe clean before fitting the limit switch box.
rules.why: Exposes the ISO 5211 pinion drive for the LSB shaft.
rules.failureMode: LSB cannot engage the pinion.

rules.text: SR40 = 4.0 barg spring version (matches AFR set 4 bar). Action code C = spring-to-CLOSE, so the package is FAIL-CLOSE: the valve closes on loss of air. Confirmed by Arnav 2026-07-16. Air supply must meet the spring rating and must not exceed 8 barg (max supply); design pressure 10 barg.
rules.why: The spring is sized for 4.0 bar; under-supply will not complete the stroke, over-supply beyond 8 bar risks the pressure-retaining parts.
rules.failureMode: Incomplete stroke, or overpressure damage.
rules.source: Valmet catalogue p4 (pressures) + p28 (order code C) + Arnav 2026-07-16

rules.text: Confirm FAIL-TO-CLOSE (spring-to-close) orientation before final torque: the valve must go CLOSED on air loss.
rules.why: Wrong orientation reverses the fail-action of the whole package.
rules.failureMode: Valve fails to the wrong position on air loss (safety).

checks.text: Actuator square to the valve before final torque.
checks.acceptance: No skew; base fully seated on bracket.
Pinion drives the stem through full travel.

hookups.detail: Operating media air/nitrogen. SR40 spring rated 4.0 barg (matches AFR set 4 bar). Max supply 8 barg, design 10 barg. Output torque RNP50-SR40 at 4 bar = 9-13 Nm (min-max over stroke). IP66/67, -20..+80 C (temp code G). Source: Valmet catalogue p4, p5.

provenance.overallConfidence: OEM-confirmed (Valmet catalogue): pressures, spring rating, ISO 5211 flanges F03/F05, 14 mm bi-square drive, NAMUR M5. Fail-action = FAIL-CLOSE (spring-to-close, code C) confirmed by Arnav 2026-07-16. Open: valve-mount torque; F-code resolved: actuator uses F05/M6 to bracket, valve is F03 (Arnav 2026-07-17).

rules.text: Select 3/2 or 5/2 per customer and set the O-ring gate to the required port before mounting.
rules.why: The same SOV body serves multiple functions; the gate sets the airflow path.
rules.failureMode: Actuator strokes the wrong way or not at all.

rules.text: Fit the rubber NAMUR plate with 2 O-rings; peel the protective film first.
rules.why: Seals the NAMUR interface; film left on prevents a seal.
rules.failureMode: Air leak at the actuator face.

rules.text: Blank all air holes except the middle (supply); fit the silencer/exhaust so it points clear.
rules.why: Only the supply port should be open; exhaust must vent freely.
rules.failureMode: Cross-porting or blocked exhaust; erratic stroke.

checks.text: Gate matches the ordered function (3/2 vs 5/2).
O-rings seated and compressed evenly; supply hole open; exhaust clear.
checks.acceptance: No visible gap; supply port open, exhaust unobstructed.

hookups.detail: 24 VDC coil, flameproof; 1/2" NPT cable entry (per BV1123 BOM family spec, confirm for SV1007).
NAMUR-ported to the actuator; supply fed from the AFR via the air train.

provenance.overallConfidence: identity confirmed; electrical entry and fastener/torque to confirm

afr.displayName: Air filter regulator (FRL), 1/4" BSP, with dial gauge

rules.text: Bowl / drain points down; mounting slots vertical for height adjustment.
rules.why: Bowl drains correctly; vertical slots let the AFR height line up with the air train.
rules.failureMode: Bowl won't drain; tube run won't align.

rules.text: Thread the dial gauge into the gauge port with PTFE on the thread; gauge readable from the front.
rules.why: Sealed, readable pressure indication.
rules.failureMode: Leak at the gauge port; unreadable gauge.

rules.text: Set regulator to 4 bar for this build.
rules.why: Config 1 set pressure.
rules.failureMode: Under/over-pressure to the actuator.

checks.text: Bowl down, gauge readable, set pressure 4 bar.
checks.acceptance: Gauge reads 4 bar with supply on.

hookups.detail: 1/4" BSP inlet via push-in supply fitting (PTFE-taped); outlet to SOV via bent pipe. Regulation range per SB10 datasheet to confirm; set 4 bar.

provenance.overallConfidence: identity confirmed; pressure range and fasteners to confirm

lsb.displayName: Limit switch box (2x SPDT) with integral mounting bracket

interfaces.role: mounts directly to actuator top via its integral bracket

fasteners.role: integral bracket feet to actuator top

rules.text: The LSB ships with its mounting bracket integral (the '+BKT' in KS2V1A2NGRNN+BKT). There is NO separate riser bracket; the box and bracket mount as ONE unit directly onto the actuator top.
rules.why: The bracket is welded/bolted to the box base and the drive shaft protrudes through it, ready to drop onto the actuator.
rules.failureMode: Modeling or ordering a separate riser that does not exist.

rules.text: Engage the LSB shaft in the pinion adapter BEFORE the nuts are pulled tight.
rules.why: Pulling nuts first prevents the shaft from seating, or shears/bends it.
rules.failureMode: Broken or disengaged shaft; no position feedback.

rules.text: Set cams to OPEN / CLOSED (round-2 test step, knowledge lives with the part).
rules.why: Cams define the switch trip points.
rules.failureMode: False open/closed signals.

checks.acceptance: Switches trip at true end positions; dome indicator reads correctly.

checks.text: Integral bracket seated square on the actuator top (VDI/VDE 3845).
checks.acceptance: Both bracket feet flat, shaft engaged in pinion before final tightening.

hookups.detail: 2x SPDT micro-switches (Honeywell V15S05 per BOM family spec); position feedback contacts. Confirm for LB1002.

provenance.overallConfidence: identity confirmed; integral bracket confirmed from shop photo 2026-07-14; switch model and fastener sizes/torque to confirm

relationships.interfaceStandard: actuator pinion drive (ISO 5211 bi-square, 14 mm A/F)

rules.text: Rotate the coupling to align the tang to the pinion; never force it.
rules.why: Forcing damages the pinion or shears the tang.
rules.failureMode: Stripped drive; no torque transmission.

rules.text: Actuator drive is a 14 mm A/F ISO 5211 bi-square female socket; the coupling must present a matching 14 mm bi-square to the actuator.
rules.why: Correct drive size for torque transmission.
rules.failureMode: Loose/stripped drive.

checks.text: Coupling tang aligned to pinion before the actuator seats.
checks.acceptance: Actuator drops on without forcing; drives through full travel.

rules.text: Engage the LSB shaft in the pinion adapter BEFORE the mounting nuts are pulled tight.
rules.why: Nuts-first stops the shaft seating or bends it.
rules.failureMode: Broken/disengaged shaft; no feedback.

fasteners.role: LSB integral bracket feet to actuator top

checks.text: Shaft engaged, integral bracket square, cams readable.

checks.text: O-rings compressed evenly; supply open; exhaust clear.
